title: Brain signals and manual execution product

tasks.title: Freeze targets and signal contracts
tasks.work: Define spot/LP/hold/exit identities, prediction horizons, expiry, portfolio context, confidence semantics and manual execution scope.
tasks.acceptance: Versioned targets and schemas distinguish research predictions, qualified proposals, manual actions and outcomes; no model is claimed trained.

tasks.title: Load and validate actual connectome
tasks.work: Verify release/license/checksums, preserve neuron/edge metadata and test direction, signs and preprocessing.
tasks.acceptance: Actual dataset drives recurrent computation; provenance and graph oracle reproduce; subset versus whole-brain coverage is explicit.

tasks.title: Build public-wallet and position observer
tasks.work: Track user/external-wallet activity with receipt/state evidence, failed transactions, position ownership, backfill and fork reconciliation.
tasks.acceptance: Supported manual swaps and LP lifecycle changes survive restart without duplicates; unknown routes remain unresolved; no keys required.

tasks.title: Create causal historical and feedback datasets
tasks.work: Combine frozen wallet cohorts and market history, preserve real acquisition times, all outcomes, ignored signals and external cash flows. Maintain a durable horizon-maturation queue for market and external-wallet outcomes even when the user does not trade.
tasks.acceptance: Chronological plus wallet/token leakage checks pass; selected winners and leader prices cannot masquerade as deployable training evidence. Zero-personal-trade intervals still produce qualified examples; delayed, missing and fork-revised labels are reconciled; predictions cannot label themselves.

tasks.title: Train biological model locally with controls
tasks.work: Implement checkpointed fixed-graph training/readout and practical ordinary, shuffled/random and no-state comparisons under matched budgets. Schedule automatic candidate training from sufficient qualified new examples and historical replay under resource budgets; measure forgetting against older data.
tasks.acceptance: A Windows/WSL2 run resumes and reproduces held-out predictions; memory/runtime measured; no whole-brain/GPU or financial edge assumption. Training runs without a user trade or manual trigger; insufficient evidence yields an honest waiting state, not a claimed update.

tasks.title: Validate spot and LP outcome accounting
tasks.work: Reuse exact per-asset ledgers and one supported quote/position family; reconcile costs, failures, residuals, marks and exits.
tasks.acceptance: Separate spot/LP readiness records reconcile independent examples; incomplete LP accounting keeps LP recommendations research-only.

tasks.title: Build brain signal inbox and position views
tasks.work: Expose versioned predictions and constrained entry/hold/exit proposals with expiry, evidence and manual-action status in the terminal UI. Display observation/label freshness, training state, candidate evaluation and active-model/promotion history.
tasks.acceptance: Real model outputs drive displayed signals; stale or unsupported outputs abstain; economic readiness is enforced per capability; all controls work.

tasks.title: Link manual actions and produce feedback
tasks.work: Record pre-action proposals, match external transaction hashes conservatively, preserve human overrides, delays, failed and partial actions.
tasks.acceptance: Supported actions auto-update positions; ambiguous links remain pending; actual and simulated counterfactual outcomes never merge.

tasks.title: Evaluate and promote model versions
tasks.work: Generate reproducible prediction and policy reports, prospective comparisons and held-out candidate-versus-active checks with rollback. Evaluate automatically trained candidates on forward windows while preserving an untouched final test and preventing repeated holdout-selection leakage.
tasks.acceptance: Scheduled retraining is automatic, recorded and independent of user activity; model promotion requires declared evaluation gates and a versioned record; model lineage, uncertainty and separate spot/LP qualification remain visible; existing timed gates remain honest.

tasks.title: Package Windows/WSL2 laboratory and watcher
tasks.work: Provide install/run/train/evaluate commands, durable storage, startup/recovery, resource limits and consistent backup/restore. Supervise durable observation, label-maturation, training and evaluation queues continuously with restart catch-up and explicit outage accounting.
tasks.acceptance: Fresh PC setup and interrupted training/collection resume are verified; heavier training does not starve ingestion; no wallet secrets required. Exercise a zero-user-trade period with automatic observation-to-label-to-training-to-evaluation progress; separate scheduling fixtures from real elapsed-time evidence.

tasks.title: Accept manual-execution brain product
tasks.work: Demonstrate real-connectome signals, user-controlled execution, verified feedback and measured retraining in one reproducible release.
tasks.acceptance: Report research/qualified status independently for spot, LP and feedback; missing live demonstrations or timed evidence remain open; no signing or automatic transactions. Demonstrate the learning cycle continuing without personal trades; failed candidate evaluation preserves the active model.

dependency_note: B dependencies govern this product track. Existing M references identify reusable work and capability acceptance gates, not a requirement to delay offline brain experiments until all M phases finish. No existing task is marked complete by this plan.
continuous_learning_requirement: Operate observation, label maturation, scheduled candidate training and evaluation 24/7 independently of personal trading activity, subject to data availability and resource budgets. Promotion is evaluated and versioned; no self-generated truth labels or fabricated uptime.
